mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (historical 25th percentile), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, a decline in UNRATE (over 1 month) is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE decline signal in high-unemployment regimes is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a contraction in industrial output, which reduces corporate production capacity and future earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a severe demand shock that reduces consumer and business confidence, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 (both down > 0.5% MoM for HOUST and >0.2% QoQ for GDPC1) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in the inflation rate signals a potential easing of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, a decline in CPIAUCSL (over 1 month) is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL decline signal in high-inflation regimes is below 0.05.
